hero.headline: NFT tickets that fans can trust — and organisers can profit from forever.
hero.subheadline: TicketPulse turns every ticket into a cryptographically signed, royalty-paying digital asset on the Base network.

wallet.title: Your ticket, your wallet
wallet.description: Non-custodial — TicketPulse never holds your funds or NFTs.

fair.title: Fair queues, fixed prices
fair.description: FIFO resale at a markup set by the organiser — bots can't snipe.

identity.title: Cryptographic identity
identity.description: EIP-712 signatures bind your name to your ticket without leaking PII.

transparency.title: Cryptographic transparency
transparency.description: Every ticket, sale, and royalty is on-chain. No hidden allocations, no opaque dynamic pricing.

fairResale.title: Strict FIFO resale
fairResale.description: First-in-first-out queues at a single fixed markup. Bots can't snipe, scalpers can't dump.

royalties.title: Automatic royalties
royalties.description: A configurable share of every resale flows back to the organiser, enforced by smart contract.

privacy.title: Privacy by default
privacy.description: Your name never touches the blockchain. Only its hash does — enough to validate at the gate.

whatIsNft.question: What is an NFT ticket, in plain terms?
whatIsNft.answer: An NFT ticket is a unique digital token bound to your wallet and verified at the venue. Think of it like a paper ticket with an unforgeable serial number — except no one can copy it.

refunds.question: Can I refund my ticket?
refunds.answer: Refunds are at the organiser's discretion and are not part of the protocol. You can always resell at the fixed price on the secondary market.

fees.question: What fees do you charge?
fees.answer: TicketPulse itself charges no platform fee. You pay the Base network gas (typically pennies) plus whatever royalty the organiser configured.

howItWorks.title: How TicketPulse works
howItWorks.intro: Three pillars: a wallet you control, an NFT only you can use, and a smart contract that enforces fair rules.

wallets.title: Step 1 — Get a wallet
wallets.body: A wallet is the key to everything you own on the blockchain. We support MetaMask, Phantom, Coinbase Wallet, and any wallet that speaks WalletConnect.

buy.title: Step 2 — Buy a ticket
buy.body: Pick an event, enter your name (latin alphabet, exactly as on your ID), and confirm two prompts in your wallet: a free signature that proves your identity, then the actual purchase.

attend.title: Step 3 — Show your QR at the door
attend.body: Generate a fresh QR code from My Tickets. It contains both your identity proof and a five-minute liveness proof. Pair it with your ID and you're in.
